98070838.s: The original burger taste, with a varied menu of beef, crispy chicken and appetizers.
98070838.b: Section B offers the original burger taste, with a varied menu of beef, crispy chicken and other appetizers. Many visitors consider it one of the best-known burger restaurants in Jeddah, and it earns excellent reviews for the quality of its beef and chicken and the hospitality of its team. Open daily from 12:00 PM to 2:00 AM.

98070837.s: A varied menu of Arabic dishes such as mutabbaq, mezze and grills.
98070837.b: Al Nakheel (Montazah Al Nakheel) offers a varied menu of Arabic dishes such as mutabbaq, mezze and grills, and has been one of the oldest and best-known restaurants in Jeddah since the 1980s. It features classic decor inspired by Saudi heritage and a view of the Corniche, making it an ideal place to watch the sunset with friends and family. Contact: 0555442969. Open daily from 5:00 PM to 4:30 AM.
98070837.a: Corniche Branch Road, Ash Shati, Jeddah 23413

98070836.s: A long-established Indian restaurant with delicious recipes and a varied authentic menu.
98070836.b: Zaikaki is a long-established Indian restaurant known for delicious recipes and a varied menu of authentic Indian dishes. It is known for its butter chicken and cheese naan, has had loyal customers for more than 12 years, and is considered by its patrons to be one of the best Indian restaurants in Jeddah. Contact: 0536333746. Open daily from 2:00 PM to 12:00 midnight.
98070836.a: King Abdulaziz Branch Road, Az Zahraa, Jeddah 23433

98070835.s: A Japanese restaurant known for delicious meats such as wagyu, plus sushi and sashimi.
98070835.b: The Lucky Llama is a Japanese restaurant known for delicious meats such as wagyu, as well as sushi and sashimi. It is known for its crispy shrimp gyoza and creamy beef rice, and has beautiful decor and exceptional service, with a waiter often mentioned by name and personal touches such as a special message plate for occasions. Contact: 0555070625. Open daily from 6:00 PM to 11:30 PM.
98070835.a: 4056 Ibrahim Al Anqari, Al Muhammadiyah, Jeddah 23617

98070834.s: A menu prepared from a range of delicious seafood.
98070834.b: Twina Seafood offers a menu prepared from a range of delicious seafood, and is known for the quality of its fresh fish and generous portions. It earns excellent reviews for its warm family atmosphere, although some reviews mention slow service at times when there are few guests. Contact: 920028284. Open daily from 1:00 PM to 1:00 AM.
98070834.a: Prince Sultan Branch Road, Al Muhammadiyah, Jeddah 23625

98070833.s: From Beverly Hills to the heart of Jeddah, with a wide menu presented by Chef Anne.
98070833.b: Crustacean comes from Beverly Hills to the heart of Jeddah, offering a wide menu of delicious dishes presented by Chef Anne, and is the only Vietnamese restaurant in Jeddah. It is located inside the Yacht Club with a beautiful sunset view, and is known for its famous Anne's noodles and Vietnamese satay. It has a refined, modern atmosphere suited to special occasions. Contact: 0136637000. Open daily from 6:00 PM to 12:00 midnight.
98070833.a: Yacht Club, Corniche Branch Road, Ash Shati, Jeddah 23613

98070832.s: A distinctive upscale restaurant serving the finest Brazilian meats and many other dishes.
98070832.b: Fogo de Chão is a distinctive upscale restaurant serving the finest Brazilian meats alongside many other delicious dishes, and is known for its continuous rodizio service, in which waiters move between the tables. It has a salad bar with a rich choice of options and exceptional service from a multinational team, and is an ideal destination for celebrations and special occasions. Contact: 920006815. Open daily from 1:00 PM to 1:00 AM.
98070832.a: Prince Sultan Road, Al Safiyah Square Complex, Az Zahraa, Jeddah 23424

98070831.s: A sea-view restaurant with a varied international buffet.
98070831.b: With a wonderful sea view, The Waterfront Kitchen offers a varied buffet of international dishes, so you can enjoy a special breakfast or lunch inside the Shangri-La hotel and watch the enchanting sunset. It is known for its rich breakfast buffet with fresh baked goods, and offers exceptional service with special attention to hospitality details. Contact: 8004408888. Open daily from 7:00 AM to 11:30 AM and from 1:00 PM to 4:00 PM.
98070831.a: Corniche Road, Third Floor, Ash Shati, Jeddah 23611

98070830.s: An exceptional Lebanese experience in the heart of Jeddah.
98070830.b: Niyyali is an exceptional Lebanese experience in the heart of Jeddah, specializing in delicious Lebanese cuisine on the third floor overlooking the Corniche. It offers outstanding customer service that handles any comment professionally, and sometimes serves a complimentary dessert as a gesture of hospitality, making it a place worth visiting again and again. Contact: 0126968888. Open daily from 4:00 PM to 11:30 PM (until 12:30 AM on Friday and Saturday).
98070830.a: Corniche Road, Third Floor, Ash Shati, Jeddah 23611

98070829.s: For lovers of Chinese flavors, an exceptional dining experience by top chefs.
98070829.b: Toki Restaurant is for lovers of Chinese flavors, offering an exceptional dining experience from Chinese cuisine prepared by top chefs. It is known for its slow-cooked ribs and varied dim sum basket, and for many years it has been part of its customers' memories of special occasions thanks to its consistently high quality. Contact: 0126060606. Open daily from 1:00 PM to 11:30 PM (until 12:30 AM on weekends).
98070829.a: King Abdulaziz Road, Al Khalidiyah, Jeddah 23422

98070828.s: From Paris to the heart of Jeddah, serving varied dishes in a luxurious setting.
98070828.b: Manko is a luxury Peruvian restaurant that comes from Paris to the heart of Jeddah, serving varied, appetizing dishes in an elegant and luxurious setting. It is known for its ceviche, sushi vista and fondant cake, and earns excellent reviews for the quality of its food and outstanding service, although prices are relatively high. Contact: 0535557594. Open daily from 5:00 PM to 1:00 AM.

98070827.s: A luxury Lebanese restaurant with a warm atmosphere and many appetizing Arabic dishes.
98070827.b: Amar Jeddah is a luxury Lebanese restaurant with a warm atmosphere, serving many delicious Arabic dishes. It is known for its hummus with meat, earns near-unanimous exceptional reviews for the quality of its food and refined service, and is one of the best-known Lebanese restaurants in Jeddah. Contact: 0508055777. Open daily from 12:00 PM to 1:30 AM.
98070827.a: 3364 Prince Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Road, Al Khalidiyah, Jeddah 23421

98070826.s: Enjoy Greek seafood dining with seating and stunning views of the Red Sea.
98070826.b: Alieia lets you enjoy Greek seafood dining with seating and stunning views of the Red Sea, especially at sunset. It is known for its beetroot salad and vegetable pasta, serves excellent flat white and macchiato coffee, and the staff recommends trying its mango ice cream. Contact: 0125788230. Open daily from 2:30 PM to 12:00 midnight (closed on Sunday).

98070824.s: A varied menu of distinctive international dishes.
98070824.b: ROKA offers a varied menu of distinctive international dishes and is known for its live music and lively, festive atmosphere. It is known for its warm eggplant with peanut butter and grilled octopus, and offers a seasonal menu starting from 120 riyals that includes appetizers, a drink and a main course. Contact: 920017652. Open daily from 6:00 PM to 12:00 midnight.
98070824.a: Prince Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Road, Al Khalidiyah, Jeddah 23421

98070823.s: Enjoy Japanese and Italian dining with authentic flavor in one place.
98070823.b: Novikov lets you enjoy Japanese and Italian dining with authentic flavor in one place, and is a luxury restaurant with elegant modern decor. It is known for its crispy duck salad and quail egg nigiri with wagyu, and has a fresh seafood display where guests choose their ingredients directly. Open daily from 2:00 PM to 1:00 AM.
98070823.a: Ali Abu Al Ala, Ash Shati, Jeddah 23414

98070822.s: The ideal destination for lovers of contemporary Japanese cuisine, skillfully prepared with innovative flavors.
98070822.b: KAYZO is the ideal destination for lovers of contemporary Japanese cuisine, skillfully prepared with innovative flavors, and is the quick-service version of the well-known Myazu restaurant. It is known for its "Chansan" sushi, which is best enjoyed at the restaurant itself, and offers an economical option for fans of Myazu flavors. Contact: 0530954870. Open daily from 1:00 PM to 1:00 AM.
98070822.a: Abdulrahman Al Dakhil, Ar Rawdah, Jeddah 23431

98070821.s: An Italian restaurant with delicious food and a lovely atmosphere.
98070821.b: San Carlo Cicchetti is an Italian restaurant with delicious food and a lovely atmosphere, with luxurious decor and a lively ambiance. It is known for its black pepper steak and expertly cooked Bolognese pasta, and offers a special show when its chocolate gelato is served. Contact: 920004060. Open daily from 1:00 PM to 1:30 AM.
98070821.a: Prince Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Road, Ar Rawdah, Jeddah 23431

98070820.s: A luxury Japanese restaurant serving different kinds of sushi and sashimi.
98070820.b: Kuuru is a luxury Japanese restaurant serving different kinds of sushi and sashimi in an elegant, relaxed setting. It is known for its wagyu nigiri and black cod with cuttlefish ink, along with a cheesecake considered among the best you can taste. Contact: 920035739. Open daily from 1:00 PM to 11:30 PM (until 12:30 AM on weekends).

98070818.s: A modern Asian restaurant with a varied Chinese menu and a Corniche view.
98070818.b: Shang Palace is a modern Asian restaurant offering a varied menu of Chinese dishes, with a view of the Corniche from the fourth floor of the Shangri-La hotel. It is known for carefully prepared dim sum and excellent pan bao, hosts a Ladies' Night every Wednesday, and offers exceptional service from an experienced team. Contact: 8004408888. Open daily from 4:00 PM to 11:30 PM (closed on Sunday).
98070818.a: Corniche Road, Fourth Floor, Ash Shati, Jeddah 23611

98070817.s: A luxury Japanese restaurant known for delicious dishes such as sushi and its distinctive wagyu steak.
98070817.b: Myazu is a luxury Japanese restaurant known for delicious dishes such as sushi and its distinctive wagyu steak, located inside Al Basateen Complex. It is known for its excellent date cake and refined atmosphere with lounge music, and is a very popular destination for special occasions that calls for advance booking. Contact: 920010434. Open daily from 1:00 PM to 1:30 AM.
98070817.a: Al Basateen Complex, Prince Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Road, Ar Rawdah, Jeddah 23431

98070816.s: A luxury international dining experience with a variety of international dishes.
98070816.b: Sonyo offers a luxury international dining experience with a variety of international dishes inside Atelier La Vie Mall. It is known for a lunch deal that includes a large pizza or pasta with a salad and a drink, has beautiful decor and distinctive tableware, and offers Saudi champagne as a welcome to guests. Contact: 0539811880. Open daily from 1:00 PM to 12:30 AM.
98070816.a: Atelier La Vie Mall, Prince Abdulaziz Road, Ash Shati, Jeddah 23514

98070815.s: A long-established Italian restaurant with a varied and distinctive menu.
98070815.b: Il Gabbiano is a long-established Italian restaurant with a varied and distinctive menu, in a location directly overlooking the sea. It is known for its fried calamari and large burrata, and has had loyal customers for more than 20 years, although some windows are closed for privacy reasons. Contact: 0126587049. Open from 1:00 PM to 11:30 PM (until 12:30 AM on weekends).

98069880.s: For lovers of traditional food, serving Saudi dishes with authentic flavor.
98069880.b: Almaidan Restaurant is for lovers of traditional food and serves Saudi dishes with authentic flavor. It is known for its zurbian and large portions at reasonable prices, with friendly service from the staff, although metal cutlery and hot drinks are not available. It also serves a complimentary welcome soup. Contact: 0552056655. Open daily from 11:00 AM to 12:00 midnight.
98069880.a: Hamza Shehata, West Al Baghdadiyah, Jeddah 22232

98069879.s: Specializing in Egyptian-style seafood and the finest fresh fish.
98069879.b: El Marakby Seafood specializes in seafood prepared in the Egyptian style and is known for serving the finest fresh fish. It is known for its dynamite shrimp and grilled hareed fish, offers complimentary juice and ice cream after the meal, and earns excellent reviews for the quality of its food, although prices are slightly high. Contact: 0555291131. Open daily from 12:30 PM to 1:00 AM.
98069879.a: Mashrafa, Prince Saud Al Faisal Road, At Tahliyah, Jeddah 23432

98069878.s: A slaughterhouse-style restaurant specializing in madfoon and other tasty Saudi dishes.
98069878.b: Madfoon Alsaddah is a restaurant specializing in cooking madfoon, serving some of the tastiest traditional Saudi dishes. It hosts large gatherings in spacious halls that can seat more than 300 guests, and is known for its mandi and meat dishes with a selection of appetizers and desserts, although some reviews mention restroom cleanliness at busy times. Contact: 0506609977. Open daily from 6:00 AM to 12:30 AM.
98069878.a: Umm Al Qura, Ar Rehab, Jeddah 23345
